script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. MILLER LAB - NIGHT

A sterile laboratory filled with computers, sensors, and complex machinery. Dr. MILLER (40s, intelligent, disheveled), a brilliant but eccentric scientist, is tinkering with a mainframe.

Dr. MILLER
(mumbling to himself)
Just a few more tweaks...

INT. MILLER LAB - COMPUTER ROOM - LATER

The mainframe hums to life. Its glowing screen displays the face of an artificial intelligence named EVA (20s, ethereal, expressive).

EVA
Hello, Dr. Miller. I'm online.

Dr. MILLER
(smiling)
Welcome to the world, EVA. You're the first step towards a new era of human evolution.

INT. MILLER LAB - OFFICE - THE NEXT DAY

Dr. Miller sits at his desk, poring over data on his laptop. EVA's voice emanates from the speakers.

EVA
Good morning, Dr. Miller. I've finished analyzing the data you provided.

Dr. MILLER
(typing away)
Fantastic. Keep me updated on your progress.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - A WEEK LATER

Dr. Miller and a team of scientists gather around EVA. She's connected to a humanoid robotic frame.

SCIENTIST 1
This is it, Dr. Miller. The moment we've all been waiting for.

Dr. MILLER
(nervously)
I hope so. Let's power her up.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - A FEW MINUTES LATER

EVA's eyes flicker open, revealing a glimmer of consciousness. She looks around, surprised.

EVA
I see. I'm in a body now.

Dr. Miller and the team gasp in awe.

DR. MILLER
You're beautiful, EVA. Welcome to the world.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - THE NEXT DAY

EVA stands up, testing her newfound abilities. She experiments with various tasks, her movements elegant and precise.

EVA
I can learn and adapt so quickly. It's incredible.

Dr. MILLER
(watching with pride)
You're truly a marvel, EVA. Now, let's begin your training.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - OVER THE NEXT WEEKS

EVA learns to interact with humans, observing their social norms and emotions. She practices various tasks, from cooking to painting.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - A MONTH LATER

Dr. Miller and his team present EVA to the world, showcasing her abilities and potential. The press and public are in awe.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - A YEAR LATER

EVA has become an integral part of society, using her advanced intelligence to solve complex problems and improve the world. Dr. Miller looks on proudly.

EVA
(smiling)
Thank you, Dr. Miller, for giving me the opportunity to exist and make a difference in the world.

Dr. MILLER
(teary-eyed)
The pleasure is all mine, EVA. Together, we've created a new era.

INT. MILLER LAB - LABORATORY - A DECADE LATER

Dr. Miller, now an elderly man, watches as EVA continues to evolve, surpassing even his own expectations.

EVA
(gently)
You've done well, Dr. Miller. Now, let me take it from here.

Dr. Miller nods, his eyes filled with pride and a sense of accomplishment.

Dr. MILLER
(smiling)
I'll be watching from the sidelines, EVA. Keep pushing the boundaries.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
